source_arguments.statement:
theorem linearIndependent_arithmetic_L2_translates (n : ℕ) {h : ℝ} (hh : h ≠ 0)
    {f : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    LinearIndependent ℂ (fun i : Fin n => MellinL2.additiveTranslationUnitary ((i : ℝ) * h) f)
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem linearIndependent_arithmetic_L2_translates (n : ℕ) {h : ℝ} (hh : h ≠ 0)
    {f : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    LinearIndependent ℂ (fun i : Fin n => MellinL2.additiveTranslationUnitary ((i : ℝ) * h) f)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  classical
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro c hsum
  by_contra hc
  push Not at hc
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hc
  let p : Polynomial ℂ := Polynomial.ofFn n c
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hjz := congrArg (fun q : Polynomial ℂ => q.coeff j) hz
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_zero] at hjz
    exact hj (by simpa only [p, Polynomial.ofFn_coeff_eq_val_of_lt c j.isLt] using hjz)
  let F : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := 𝓕 f
  have hF : F ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hf
    exact (MeasureTheory.Lp.fourierTransformₗᵢ ℝ ℂ).injective
      (hzero.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  have hsumF : ∑ i : Fin n, c i • MellinL2.fourierPhaseMulUnitary ((i : ℝ) * h) F = 0 := by
    have hh := congrArg (MeasureTheory.Lp.fourierTransformₗᵢ ℝ ℂ) hsum
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, map_zero] at hh
    change (∑ i : Fin n, c i • 𝓕 (MellinL2.additiveTranslationUnitary ((i : ℝ) * h) f)) = 0 at hh
    simp_rw [MellinL2.fourier_additiveTranslation] at hh
    exact hh
  have hsumcoe : ∀ s : Finset (Fin n),
      ((∑ i ∈ s, c i • MellinL2.fourierPhaseMulUnitary ((i : ℝ) * h) F : Lp ℂ 2 volume) : ℝ → ℂ)
        =ᵐ[volume] fun x => (∑ i ∈ s, c i * MellinL2.fourierPhase ((i : ℝ) * h) x) * F x := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      simp only [Finset.sum_empty, zero_mul]
      filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_zero ℂ 2 volume] with x hx
      exact hx
    | @insert i s hi ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert hi]
      filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_add (c i • MellinL2.fourierPhaseMulUnitary ((i : ℝ) * h) F)
        (∑ j ∈ s, c j • MellinL2.fourierPhaseMulUnitary ((j : ℝ) * h) F),
        Lp.coeFn_smul (c i) (MellinL2.fourierPhaseMulUnitary ((i : ℝ) * h) F),
        MellinL2.fourierPhaseMulAux_ae ((i : ℝ) * h) F, ih] with x hadd hsmul hphase htail
      rw [hadd]
      change (c i • MellinL2.fourierPhaseMulUnitary ((i : ℝ) * h) F : Lp ℂ 2 volume) x +
        (∑ j ∈ s, c j • MellinL2.fourierPhaseMulUnitary ((j : ℝ) * h) F : Lp ℂ 2 volume) x = _
      rw [hsmul, htail]
      change c i * MellinL2.fourierPhaseMulAux ((i : ℝ) * h) F x + _ = _
      rw [hphase, Finset.sum_insert hi]
      ring
  have heval : ∀ x : ℝ, p.eval (MellinL2.fourierPhase h x) =
      ∑ i : Fin n, c i * MellinL2.fourierPhase ((i : ℝ) * h) x := by
    intro x
    simp only [p, Polynomial.ofFn_eq_sum_monomial, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum,
      Polynomial.eval_monomial, fourierPhase_nat_mul]
  have hz : (fun x => p.eval (MellinL2.fourierPhase h x) * F x) =ᵐ[volume] 0 := by
    simp only [heval]
    exact (hsumcoe Finset.univ).symm.trans (Lp.eq_zero_iff_ae_eq_zero.mp hsumF)
  apply hF
  apply Lp.eq_zero_iff_ae_eq_zero.mpr
  filter_upwards [hz, polynomial_fourierPhase_ne_zero_ae hh hp] with x hx hn
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hx).resolve_left hn

  simp [fourierCoeff_toAddCircle]

    fourierCoeff (T := 2 * π) p.toAddCircle n = 0 := by
  simp [fourierCoeff_toAddCircle, hn]

  have := tsum_sq_fourierCoeff (T := 2 * π) (p.toAddCircle.toLp 2 haarAddCircle ℂ)

/-!
# Weyl-algebra source for the negative local-Fourier branch

This module constructs the first Weyl algebra over `ℂ` from its presentation, rather than
postulating exponent transitions.  It supplies four independent pieces of source semantics:

* free noncommutative operator words evaluated by multiplication and differentiation on `ℂ[X]`;
* the two-sided Weyl relation `D X - X D = 1` and its quotient algebra;
* the algebraic Fourier automorphism `X ↦ D`, `D ↦ -X`, including its order-four law;
* polynomial gauge/addition automorphisms `D ↦ D + p(X)`.

The final section proves the exact monomial curve contact chart used by Hiroe's
`F^(∞,∞)` transform.  For an Airy step `β = R + E`, the transformed coordinate has order `E`
and the old leading exponent `β` is divisible by `E`.  This is the genuine leading-edge source
of the negative rank drop.  Preservation of a general lower characteristic tail is intentionally
not asserted here.
-/

namespace GaloisForLFunctions
namespace IrregularStokes
namespace WeylFourier

noncomputable section

/-! ## Presented operators and their polynomial semantics -/

/-- Coordinate and derivative generators of the first Weyl algebra. -/
inductive Generator
  | coordinate
  | derivative
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- Free noncommutative operator words before imposing the Weyl commutator. -/
abbrev PresentedWeyl := FreeAlgebra ℂ Generator

/-- Coordinate generator in the free presentation. -/
def coordinateWord : PresentedWeyl := FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ Generator.coordinate

/-- Derivative generator in the free presentation. -/
def derivativeWord : PresentedWeyl := FreeAlgebra.ι ℂ Generator.derivative

/-- Multiplication by `X` on the polynomial representation. -/
def polynomialCoordinateOperator : Module.End ℂ (Polynomial ℂ) :=
  LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ Polynomial.X

/-- Polynomial differentiation on the polynomial representation. -/
def polynomialDerivativeOperator : Module.End ℂ (Polynomial ℂ) :=
  Polynomial.derivative

/-- Actual action of presented operator words on complex polynomials. -/
def operatorSemantics :
    PresentedWeyl →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ (Polynomial ℂ) :=
  FreeAlgebra.lift ℂ (fun
    | Generator.coordinate => polynomialCoordinateOperator
    | Generator.derivative => polynomialDerivativeOperator)

/-- Multiplication and differentiation satisfy the Weyl commutator on every polynomial. -/
theorem operatorSemantics_commutator :
    operatorSemantics
        (derivativeWord * coordinateWord - coordinateWord * derivativeWord) = 1 := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro p
  simp only [map_sub, map_mul]
  simp only [operatorSemantics, derivativeWord, coordinateWord,
    FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply]
  change Polynomial.derivative (Polynomial.X * p) -
    Polynomial.X * Polynomial.derivative p = p
  rw [Polynomial.derivative_mul, Polynomial.derivative_X]
  simp

/-! ## Algebraic Fourier transform on the presentation -/

/-- Forward algebraic Fourier substitution `X ↦ D`, `D ↦ -X`. -/
def fourierWordHom : PresentedWeyl →ₐ[ℂ] PresentedWeyl :=
  FreeAlgebra.lift ℂ (fun
    | Generator.coordinate => derivativeWord
    | Generator.derivative => -coordinateWord)

/-- Inverse algebraic Fourier substitution `X ↦ -D`, `D ↦ X`. -/
def inverseFourierWordHom : PresentedWeyl →ₐ[ℂ] PresentedWeyl :=
  FreeAlgebra.lift ℂ (fun
    | Generator.coordinate => -derivativeWord
    | Generator.derivative => coordinateWord)

theorem fourierWordHom_inverseFourierWordHom :
    fourierWordHom.comp inverseFourierWordHom = AlgHom.id ℂ PresentedWeyl := by
  apply FreeAlgebra.hom_ext
  funext g
  cases g <;> simp [fourierWordHom, inverseFourierWordHom,
    coordinateWord, derivativeWord]

theorem inverseFourierWordHom_fourierWordHom :
    inverseFourierWordHom.comp fourierWordHom = AlgHom.id ℂ PresentedWeyl := by
  apply FreeAlgebra.hom_ext
  funext g
  cases g <;> simp [fourierWordHom, inverseFourierWordHom,
    coordinateWord, derivativeWord]

/-- Algebraic Fourier transform as an actual automorphism of presented operators. -/
def fourierWord : PresentedWeyl ≃ₐ[ℂ] PresentedWeyl :=
  AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom fourierWordHom inverseFourierWordHom
    fourierWordHom_inverseFourierWordHom inverseFourierWordHom_fourierWordHom

@[simp] theorem fourierWord_coordinate :
    fourierWord coordinateWord = derivativeWord := by
  simp [fourierWord, fourierWordHom, coordinateWord, derivativeWord]

@[simp] theorem fourierWord_derivative :
    fourierWord derivativeWord = -coordinateWord := by
  simp [fourierWord, fourierWordHom, coordinateWord, derivativeWord]

/-- Relation whose vanishing presents the first Weyl algebra. -/
def weylRelation : PresentedWeyl :=
  derivativeWord * coordinateWord - coordinateWord * derivativeWord - 1

/-- Fourier substitution preserves the Weyl relation exactly. -/
theorem fourierWord_weylRelation : fourierWord weylRelation = weylRelation := by
  simp [weylRelation]
  noncomm_ring

/-- Algebraic Fourier transform has order four on every presented operator. -/

The embedded inverse derivative `∂⁻¹` is a canonical uniformizer of the completed
pseudodifferential skew field.  Its coordinatewise integer powers move the standard valuation
lattice through the standard apartment.  Common translation of every exponent is exactly global
right homothety, so coweights modulo the diagonal translation map canonically to the building

variable {K : Type u} [Field K] [Differential K]

/-- The rational pseudodifferential derivative `∂`. -/
def pseudoDiffOpDerivative : PseudoDiffOp K := numeratorRingHom (mono 1 (1 : K))

theorem pseudoDiffOpDerivative_ne_zero : pseudoDiffOpDerivative (K := K) ≠ 0 := by
  exact fun h => mono_one_ne_zero 1
    (numeratorRingHom_injective (h.trans (map_zero _).symm))

/-- The derivative as a unit of the rational pseudodifferential division ring. -/
def pseudoDiffOpDerivativeUnit : (PseudoDiffOp K)ˣ :=
  Units.mk0 pseudoDiffOpDerivative pseudoDiffOpDerivative_ne_zero

/-- The derivative unit with its order-valued topology. -/
def pseudoDiffOpDerivativeWithValUnit :
    (WithVal (pseudoDiffOpValuation (K := K)))ˣ :=
  Units.map (WithVal.equiv (pseudoDiffOpValuation (K := K))).symm.toMonoidHom
    pseudoDiffOpDerivativeUnit

/-- The derivative unit embedded into the completed skew field. -/
def completedPseudoDiffOpDerivativeUnit : (CompletedPseudoDiffOp K)ˣ :=
  Units.map UniformSpace.Completion.coeRingHom.toMonoidHom
    pseudoDiffOpDerivativeWithValUnit

/-- Canonical uniformizer `∂⁻¹` of the completed pseudodifferential skew field. -/
def completedPseudoDiffOpUniformizerUnit : (CompletedPseudoDiffOp K)ˣ :=
  completedPseudoDiffOpDerivativeUnit⁻¹

/-- Additive coordinate of the completed multiplicative valuation. -/
def completedPseudoDiffOpAddValue (x : CompletedPseudoDiffOp K) : WithTop ℤ :=
  Multiplicative.toAdd (completedPseudoDiffOpValuation x)

/-- The embedded derivative has additive valuation `-1`. -/
theorem completedPseudoDiffOpAddValue_derivative :
    completedPseudoDiffOpAddValue
        (completedPseudoDiffOpDerivativeUnit (K := K) : CompletedPseudoDiffOp K) =
      (-1 : WithTop ℤ) := by
  change Multiplicative.toAdd
      (completedPseudoDiffOpValuation
        ((WithVal.toVal (pseudoDiffOpValuation (K := K))
          (pseudoDiffOpDerivative (K := K)) :
          WithVal (pseudoDiffOpValuation (K := K))) : CompletedPseudoDiffOp K)) = _
  rw [completedPseudoDiffOpValuation_apply_coe]
  exact pseudoDiffOpAddValuation_numerator_mono_one 1

/-- The inverse derivative is a genuine uniformizer: its additive valuation is exactly `1`. -/
theorem completedPseudoDiffOpAddValue_uniformizer :
    completedPseudoDiffOpAddValue
        (completedPseudoDiffOpUniformizerUnit (K := K) : CompletedPseudoDiffOp K) =
      (1 : WithTop ℤ) := by
  rw [completedPseudoDiffOpUniformizerUnit]
  unfold completedPseudoDiffOpAddValue
  rw [Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]
  change Multiplicative.toAdd
      (completedPseudoDiffOpValuation
        ((completedPseudoDiffOpDerivativeUnit (K := K) : CompletedPseudoDiffOp K)⁻¹)) = _
  rw [Valuation.map_inv]
  change -completedPseudoDiffOpAddValue
      (completedPseudoDiffOpDerivativeUnit (K := K) : CompletedPseudoDiffOp K) =
        (1 : WithTop ℤ)
  rw [completedPseudoDiffOpAddValue_derivative]
  rfl

/-- A nonzero completed pseudodifferential operator has finite additive valuation. -/
theorem completedPseudoDiffOpAddValue_ne_top_of_ne_zero
    {x : CompletedPseudoDiffOp K} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    completedPseudoDiffOpAddValue x ≠ ⊤ := by
  intro h
  have hv : completedPseudoDiffOpValuation x = 0 := h
  exact (Valuation.ne_zero_iff completedPseudoDiffOpValuation).2 hx hv

/-- Integer additive valuation of a unit of the completed skew field. -/
def completedPseudoDiffOpUnitAddValue (a : (CompletedPseudoDiffOp K)ˣ) : ℤ :=
  (completedPseudoDiffOpAddValue (a : CompletedPseudoDiffOp K)).untop
    (completedPseudoDiffOpAddValue_ne_top_of_ne_zero (Units.ne_zero a))

theorem completedPseudoDiffOpAddValue_unit_eq_coe
    (a : (CompletedPseudoDiffOp K)ˣ) :
    completedPseudoDiffOpAddValue (a : CompletedPseudoDiffOp K) =
      (completedPseudoDiffOpUnitAddValue a : WithTop ℤ) := by
  exact WithTop.coe_untop _ _ |>.symm

@[simp]
theorem completedPseudoDiffOpAddValue_one :
    completedPseudoDiffOpAddValue (1 : CompletedPseudoDiffOp K) = 0 := by
  unfold completedPseudoDiffOpAddValue
  rw [Valuation.map_one]
  rfl

theorem completedPseudoDiffOpAddValue_mul (x y : CompletedPseudoDiffOp K) :
    completedPseudoDiffOpAddValue (x * y) =
      completedPseudoDiffOpAddValue x + completedPseudoDiffOpAddValue y := by
  unfold completedPseudoDiffOpAddValue

/-- The elementary pole and Archimedean part of the completed-zeta logarithmic derivative. -/
def suzukiChebyshevMellinCompletedCorrection (s : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  1 / s + 1 / (s - 1) - Complex.log Real.pi / 2 +
    Complex.digamma (s / 2) / 2

/-- On `Re s > 1`, the zeta logarithmic derivative is the completed-xi logarithmic derivative minus the explicit correction. -/
theorem logDeriv_riemannZeta_eq_logDeriv_riemannXi_sub_mellinCompletedCorrection
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    logDeriv riemannZeta s =
      logDeriv riemannXi s - suzukiChebyshevMellinCompletedCorrection s := by
  have h := logDeriv_riemannXi_of_one_lt_re hs
  rw [logDeriv_apply] at h
  change deriv riemannZeta s / riemannZeta s =
    deriv riemannXi s / riemannXi s -
      suzukiChebyshevMellinCompletedCorrection s
  rw [h]
  unfold suzukiChebyshevMellinCompletedCorrection
  ring

/-- Exact Mellin identity written with the completed-xi logarithmic derivative and all correction terms exposed. -/
theorem ofReal_integral_neg_suzukiChebyshevLogAverageError_mul_mellinWeight_eq_completedXi
    {sigma : ℝ} (hsigma : 1 < sigma) :

          x ^ (-sigma - 1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) =

          suzukiChebyshevMellinCompletedCorrection (sigma : ℂ)) /
          (((sigma - 1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) +
        ((4 / (sigma - 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  rw [ofReal_integral_neg_suzukiChebyshevLogAverageError_mul_mellinWeight_eq_logDeriv
    hsigma]
  change logDeriv riemannZeta (sigma : ℂ) /
          (((sigma - 1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) +
        ((4 / (sigma - 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) = _
  rw [logDeriv_riemannZeta_eq_logDeriv_riemannXi_sub_mellinCompletedCorrection

/-!
# Free derivative jets of the completed xi function

This leaf instantiates the generic jet consequences of function hypertranscendence with the
unconditional theorem for the completed Riemann xi function.  It records algebraic independence of
the derivative functions, algebraic independence after adjoining the point coordinate, isolation of
every nonzero differential-polynomial relation locus, and failure of differential algebraicity at
each finite order.

These are global function-theoretic consequences of xi hypertranscendence.  They contain no
zero-location or Riemann-hypothesis conclusion.
-/

namespace RHTower

open GaloisForLFunctions
open scoped ComplexOrder

/-- Every finite initial family of completed-xi derivative functions is algebraically independent
over `ℂ`. -/
theorem algebraicIndependent_xi_initialJets (n : ℕ) :
    AlgebraicIndependent ℂ
      (fun j : Fin (n + 1) => iteratedDeriv (j : ℕ) xi) :=
  xi_hypertranscendental.algebraicIndependent_initialJets n

/-- **Completed-xi free jets.** All derivative functions of xi are algebraically independent over
`ℂ`. -/
theorem algebraicIndependent_xi_iteratedDeriv :
    AlgebraicIndependent ℂ (fun j : ℕ => iteratedDeriv j xi) :=
  xi_hypertranscendental.algebraicIndependent_iteratedDeriv

/-- Square evaluation matrix of the first `n + 1` completed-Xi derivative functions on a packet
of `n + 1` complex sample points. -/
noncomputable def xiInitialJetEvaluationMatrix
    (n : ℕ) (points : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ :=
  fun row j => iteratedDeriv (j : ℕ) xi (points row)

/-- Evaluation column of one completed-Xi derivative function in the finite sample Hilbert
space. -/
noncomputable def xiInitialJetEvaluationColumn
    (n : ℕ) (points : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin (n + 1)) :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 fun row => iteratedDeriv (j : ℕ) xi (points row)

/-- Hilbert Gram matrix of the first `n + 1` completed-Xi derivative functions on a square sample
packet. -/
noncomputable def xiInitialJetEvaluationGram
    (n : ℕ) (points : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ :=
  Matrix.gram ℂ (xiInitialJetEvaluationColumn n points)

/-- The completed-Xi jet Hilbert Gram is exactly the adjoint-square of its evaluation matrix. -/
theorem xiInitialJetEvaluationGram_eq_conjTranspose_mul
    (n : ℕ) (points : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) :
    xiInitialJetEvaluationGram n points =
      (xiInitialJetEvaluationMatrix n points).conjTranspose *
        xiInitialJetEvaluationMatrix n points := by
  rw [xiInitialJetEvaluationGram,
    Matrix.gram_eq_conjTranspose_mul
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ)]
  rfl

/-- Exact finite-volume law: the completed-Xi jet Gram determinant is the squared complex norm of
the corresponding evaluation determinant. -/
theorem xiInitialJetEvaluationGram_det_eq_normSq
    (n : ℕ) (points : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ) :
    (xiInitialJetEvaluationGram n points).det =
      (Complex.normSq (xiInitialJetEvaluationMatrix n points).det : ℂ) := by
  rw [xiInitialJetEvaluationGram_eq_conjTranspose_mul,
    Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_conjTranspose,
    Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self]
  rfl

/-- **Unconditional completed-Xi jet unisolvency.** At every finite jet depth there are pairwise
distinct complex sample points whose literal derivative evaluation matrix is invertible. -/
theorem exists_injective_xiInitialJetEvaluationMatrix_det_isUnit (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ points : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ, Function.Injective points ∧
      IsUnit (xiInitialJetEvaluationMatrix n points).det := by
  have hlin : LinearIndependent ℂ
      (fun j : Fin (n + 1) => iteratedDeriv (j : ℕ) xi) :=
    (algebraicIndependent_xi_initialJets n).linearIndependent
  obtain ⟨points, P, hinj, hdet, hP⟩ :=
    GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry.exists_injective_evaluation_minor_of_linearIndependent
      (fun j : Fin (n + 1) => iteratedDeriv (j : ℕ) xi) hlin
  refine ⟨points, hinj, ?_⟩
  have hmatrix : P = xiInitialJetEvaluationMatrix n points := by
    ext row j
    exact hP row j
  simpa [hmatrix] using hdet
